## Trigger

When the new basicly release is published, I want terminal to use it, so I can use native Codex permissions without generated basicly policies.

## Scope

- `.basicly/**`
- `.agents/**`
- `.claude/**`
- `.codex/**`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `.github/**`
- `.vscode/tasks.json`
- `terminal_setup/configs.py`
- `docs/contributing.md`
- `docs/validation/basicly-v0.26.10.md`

## Confirmation Plan

Install the published v0.26.10 wheel, align existing basicly pins, run all configured checks and projection checks, verify Codex cleanup, and compare consumer settings and overlays with their saved bytes.
